description: Writes a robots.txt file that allows or blocks AI crawlers by purpose: model training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended), AI search (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) and user-triggered fetches (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User), plus paths to keep private and a sitemap. Never blocks Googlebot.

ai_search.description: Whether AI search crawlers may crawl the site.

ai_training.description: Whether AI model training crawlers may crawl the site.

ai_user_fetch.description: Whether assistants may fetch pages when a user asks about them.

disallow_paths.description: Optional paths to keep out of all crawlers, each starting with /, for example /wp-admin/.

sitemap_url.description: Optional full sitemap URL, for example https://example.com/sitemap.xml.

name: robots_txt_generator
title: robots.txt generator for AI crawlers
